
# Prioritisation Approach

Functionality was prioritised based on four criteria:

| Criterion            | Description                                    |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Strategic Importance | Alignment with project outcomes                |
| Technical Dependency | Required before later functionality            |
| Feasibility          | Delivery within available resources            |
| Reusability          | Applicability across ecosystems                |

Priority decisions were informed by workshop feedback, use cases, user stories, project deliverables and partner discussions.
